definitions.status: post hoc descriptive; equal-fold metrics remain primary
definitions.limits: No causal leakage effect, independent replication, geological or global accuracy claim.
definitions.units: JSON/CSV scores and differences are fractions unless named _pp; TeX uses percent/points.
definitions.m1: Pool fold confusion counts within each adaptation seed, calculate metrics, then average seeds; LR pooled once.
definitions.m2: Common LR only; center distance strictly below exact split threshold from any reinstated training center. Average five draws, retain all four models/five folds.
definitions.m3: Map polygon parts are not physical craters; one-tile leverage changes the selection metric, not a demonstrated counterfactual selected epoch.
definitions.confusion: Rows are reference classes, columns predicted classes. Pooled LR counts test each tile once.
definitions.empty_subsets: Zero support yields null error rates, not zero error.
definitions.display: Only TeX is rounded (two decimals); JSON and CSV retain binary64 precision and integer counts.
